title: External global Hom evaluation interface
statement: Fix a commutative ring A and schemes X,Y,P in the common module universe. Use ordinary module-valued sheaves, their total cochain tensor and unbounded derived categories with the conventions [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-size-convention], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-kun-derived-tensor], [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], [def-pur-hom-complex], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-triangulated-category], [def-kun-constant-sheaf], [def-pur-kinjective-complex], [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], [lem-pur-kflat-map-factorization], [def-kun-constant-projection-morphism], [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor], [def-pur-derived-constant-pullback-comparison], [def-pur-etale-constant-scalar-realization]. Define globalHom to be derived internal Hom followed by derived global sections. Its transpose is the composite constant/sections and closed tensor/Hom adjunction, with the coefficient on the left via the Koszul braiding. Define evaluation by its counit, pulledEvaluation by the canonical constant and monoidal inverse-image comparisons, and pairing as the transpose of their external tensor. Retain the global Hom complex with differential d_I f - (-1)^n f d_E, the componentwise chain-evaluation normalization, the evaluation-normalized HomModel, the K-flat lifted external chain normalization, all four variances, the canonical open-restriction square, the signed Hom-shift normalization by leftUnshift and the two specified coefficient-cone assertions. All auxiliary named structure caches are the existing native structures; no new tensor, inverse image, or chosen evaluation is introduced. HasKoszulBraiding uses NativeBraidingAt from [lem-pur-external-rhom-derived-braiding], with exactly the same K-flat premises: this is the native Q tensor/braiding equation at ordinary module sheaves. IsNatural is the exact four-variance square [lem-pur-external-rhom-evaluation-naturality], instantiated with the original composite adjunctions and canonical comparison maps. GenericExternal.pairing_eq_pairingOf checks the construction against the same generic factory. The separate constantPullbackIso names the original comparison composite without changing it.
